fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-06-01, the complainant reported constant unwanted calls at odd hours from a person who refused to stop. The time of the incident was given as 12:25 on 2026-06-01. The complainant, Abirami Sekar, provided the contact number 9000000186. A witness, Rajesh Krishnan, reachable on 9000000167, was mentioned in the complaint. Ganesh Shankar (mobile 9000000155) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Repeated calls and messages allegedly sent from the same number.
fields.Keywords: harassment, phone calls, shopping complex, suspect, afternoon, witness, phone records, mobile number
